name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring replacement project varies based on the type of flooring, the area size, and any necessary subfloor preparation. Generally, a single room can take 1-3 days, while a whole-house project might range from 3 to 10 days. This includes old flooring removal, subfloor inspection and repair, and new flooring installation. Complex patterns or custom work can extend this timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: A flooring replacement project can take 1-3 days for a single room and 3-10 days for an entire house, depending on scope and flooring type.
